headlines.text: Rewind to 2023, when Orange Cassidy vs. Wheeler Yuta went to battle over the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.14 ? a fantastic contest. Yuta showed a more aggressive side after Claudio Castagnoli fired him up at ringside, but Cassidy's Orange Punch and Beach Break combination proved too much in a match many called an instant classic.
That Saturday in 2025, Hologram made their return to AEW television after just over 4 months away, appearing on Collision.
It was 2021 when Yuka Sakazaki vs. Emi Sakura locked horns for the first time on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 7.81 ? a strong outing.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2025, the ROH World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Chris Jericho vs. Bandido went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 7.19 ? a well-worked match.
2023 brought us this moment: Aussie Open kicked off their AEW journey as a team in a Battle Royal match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.39.
Back on this day in 2021, Ryo Mizunami vs. Aja Kong met in a Tournament Match on AEW Women's World Title Tournament, rated 6.77 ? part of that year's USA and Japan Brackets.
